HomeFeatures.whatIsPerspectiveDescription: Perspective addresses the critical problem of biased and one-sided narratives in online articles. Our AI-powered solution provides readers with fact-based, well-structured alternative perspectives by analyzing article content, extracting key arguments, and generating reasoned counter-points.
HomeFeatures.card1Desc: Advanced NLP and LangGraph pipeline extracts key claims and balances polarized discourse.
HomeFeatures.card2Desc: Identifies emotional, selective, or ideological bias in written content.
HomeFeatures.card3Desc: Cross-references claims with reliable real-time web search and citation verification.
HomeFeatures.card4Desc: Stores semantic embeddings in Pinecone for contextual, interactive chat exploration.

About.title: What is Perspective?
About.subtitle: Perspective addresses the critical problem of biased and one-sided narratives in online articles. Our AI-powered solution provides readers with fact-based, well-structured alternative perspectives by analyzing article content, extracting key points, and generating logical counter-perspectives using cutting-edge natural language processing technology.
About.missionDesc: Modern recommendation algorithms reward engagement, often feeding readers content that reinforces pre-existing biases. Readers rarely see thoughtful counter-perspectives, diminishing nuance and polarizing public discourse.
About.step1Desc: Extracts clean article prose with automated noise reduction and keyword extraction.
About.step2Desc: Evaluates tone, emotional valence, and potential ideological framing.
About.step3Desc: Queries trusted search sources to verify or contextualize detected claims.
About.step4Desc: Generates structured alternative perspectives evaluated by an internal LLM judge.
About.step5Desc: Vectorizes perspectives into Pinecone to enable real-time interactive Q&A.
About.footer: © 2026 AOSSIE. Combating bias through AI-powered perspective analysis.
